overview: Global 2025 roadmap for entry → mid‐level DevOps roles. Covers core foundations, automation, cloud & infra, monitoring, security, emergent trends, plus strong project ideas freshers can use to build experience.

steps.title: Linux, OS & Networking Fundamentals
steps.description: Understand under-the-hood of systems; essential for all DevOps tasks.
subtopics: Linux command line: navigation, processes, permissions, logs
Basics of networking: IP, DNS, HTTP/S, CORS, Ports, firewalls

steps.title: Scripting & Programming for DevOps
steps.description: Automate tasks, glue infra together, write utilities and tools.
subtopics: Bash / Shell scripting: common tasks, parsing files, automation
Python (or another general-purpose language): file IO, APIs, modules
Go (optional): especially for performance, tools, CLI
Version control & Git: branching, merging, workflows

steps.title: Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
steps.description: Automating build, test, deploy pipelines to deliver safely and frequently.
subtopics: Tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI
Rollbacks, blue/green & canary deployments, feature flags

steps.title: Containers & Orchestration
steps.description: Package, run, scale, and manage containerized applications.
subtopics: Docker fundamentals: images, containers, volumes, networking, Dockerfile optimization
Kubernetes basics: pods, deployments, services, ingress controllers

steps.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Configuration Management
steps.description: Provision and maintain infrastructure reproducibly and codified.
subtopics: Terraform: basics, modules, state, remote state, versioning
Ansible, Chef, Puppet for configuration management / task automation

steps.title: Cloud Platforms & Serverless Infrastructure
steps.description: Set up, operate, scale backend systems in cloud & serverless environments.
subtopics: AWS / Azure / GCP basics: compute, storage, IAM, networking
Serverless functions (Lambda / GCP Functions / Azure Functions)
VPCs, subnets, security groups / firewall rules

steps.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
steps.description: Make systems transparent: know when things break and why.
subtopics: Logging infrastructure: log aggregation (e.g. ELK Stack), structured logs
Alerting, incident response, SLO / SLA concepts

steps.title: Security, Compliance & DevSecOps
steps.description: Embed security throughout the DevOps lifecycle to build reliable & safe systems.
subtopics: Secure by default: SSH keys, secrets management, secure storage
IAM least-privilege, network security, firewall rules
Compliance frameworks if relevant (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)

steps.title: Performance, Reliability & Scaling
steps.description: Ensuring systems remain performant, resilient and scalable under load.
subtopics: Load testing, stress testing (tools like k6, Locust)
Fault tolerance: retries, timeouts, circuit breakers
High availability & disaster recovery (backup & restore, multi-region deployment)

steps.title: Soft Skills & Best Practices
steps.description: Collaboration, documentation, and mindset that helps you from entry to mid level.
subtopics: Good communication between devs, ops, SRE

steps.title: Emerging Trends & AI in DevOps
steps.description: What’s rising and can give you a competitive edge in DevOps roles soon.
subtopics: AI/ML aided operations (AIOps): anomaly detection, predictive scaling, automated root-cause analysis

steps.title: Capstone Projects & Freshers Showcase Ideas
steps.description: Projects that let you display full DevOps pipeline and thinking — more than simple deployment apps.

projects.name: CI/CD Pipeline End-to-End Demo
projects.description: Build a multi-service app (e.g., frontend + backend) and set up a full CI/CD pipeline with automated tests, linting, containerization, and blue/green or canary deploys.
showcase_tips: Show test coverage & linting in pipeline

projects.name: Infrastructure as Code Project
projects.description: Define infra for an app using Terraform (or equivalent), include networking, storage, compute, IAM policies; deploy and tear down reliably.

projects.name: Monitoring & Observability Dashboard
projects.description: Deploy sample app + instrument it: logs, metrics, tracing; set up alerts; show dashboards and simulate failures to see alerts triggered.
tech_stack: sample app (could be simple HTTP server)

projects.name: Serverless Microservices Setup
projects.description: Build microservices functions deployed serverless; integrate IAM, environment variables; autoscaling; minimal latency; integrate with cloud storage or queues.
tech_stack: AWS Lambda / Azure Functions / GCP Functions

projects.name: Multi-Cloud & Cost Optimization Case Study
projects.description: Use two cloud providers (free or minimal billing), deploy similar services, compare cost, latency, ease of use; show how to optimize cost/resources.
